messages:
Maya Chen: Hey team :wave: PulseWare confirmed for early access to Dedicated capacity starting next week. Need a quick sync on the intake checklist — SSO, data access, kickoff, feedback loop. Who wants to own the kickoff agenda? FYI finance flagged renewal sensitivity if integration stretches beyond ~8 weeks.

pilot-bot: New customer 'PulseWare' added to Early Access roster. Assigned CSM: Arjun Patel. :robot_face:

Arjun Patel: I can own the kickoff. Available Tue/Wed mornings PST. Thinking 30m intro + 60m tech deep dive. Need SE presence for infra and SSO items. @Lena Ortiz can you cover SSO + env prep?

Lena Ortiz: Yep, I got SSO + env prep. Will drop a short pre-kick checklist tonight. They need SAML + SCIM. Reference doc: https://redwood.ai/docs/sso-prep

Sam Nguyen: I'll handle staging access and the sample dataset upload flow. Ask PulseWare to send a representative CSV by EOD Mon. I'll attach the data-sanitization runbook to the invite.

Maya Chen: Perfect. Sam — can you also capture ETA to first inference and any blockers? We'll use that to update the renewal-risk note for the account.

Jordi Alvarez: From product: we'll run a 15-min feedback touch two weeks after kickoff to capture qualitative pain points. Can we point them to the short feedback form? https://forms.gle/example

Arjun Patel: Kickoff booked Tue 11:00 PST — invites sent. Agenda: intros, SSO checklist, staging prep, timeline & success metrics. @Maya I'll add the renewal sensitivity and acceptance criteria to the meeting notes.

Maya Chen: Thanks. Also ask them for expected query volume (qps/day) and typical prompt sizes so we can estimate token consumption and cost. I'll create a shared sheet for tracking.

Lena Ortiz: Pre-kick checklist posted in the invite:
- SAML metadata
- SCIM admin account
- Sample corpus location
- Engineering POC + contact
Ping if I missed anything :thumbsup:

Arjun Patel: Confirmed with PulseWare — they'll provide sample CSV and SAML metadata by EOD Mon. Their primary POC is emily@pulseware.com (shared privately in the invite).

Maya Chen: Last ask — if anything looks like a blocker >3 days, create a GH issue and tag it early-access/pulseware and label severity:P1/P2. I'll monitor for renewal risk impact.

pilot-bot: Reminder: use label 'early-access/pulseware' for related issues. I will surface any P1s in the morning digest.

Lena Ortiz: I'll follow up with a short SSO run-through doc and a minimal test plan for the kickoff.

Sam Nguyen: I'll prepare staging creds and a one-click sample ingest demo step for the call. See you all on Tue.

Maya Chen: Awesome — thanks everyone. I'll send a brief checklist to PulseWare and close out pre-kick items today. :calendar:
